verdict.rationale: Devin is delivered as a cloud-hosted agent platform (web app, API, session creation, scheduling) with no mention of self-hosting backend infra required — tasks can be delegated to 'cloud Devin' via handoff, Slack/Teams, web app, or API. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of infrastructure-free operation at scale, and details on managed compute/cost model beyond docs claims.
